UPDATE groupbuy_team SET paid_count=paid_count+1, status=CASE WHEN paid_count+1 >= (SELECT group_size FROM groupbuy_campaign WHERE id=groupbuy_team.campaign_id) AND member_count >= (SELECT group_size FROM groupbuy_campaign WHERE id=groupbuy_team.campaign_id) THEN 2 ELSE status END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{teamId} AND status=1 AND paid_count < member_count

UPDATE groupbuy_team SET member_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member WHERE team_id=#{teamId} AND status IN (0,1)), paid_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groupbuy_member WHERE team_id=#{teamId} AND status=1), leader_user_id=COALESCE((SELECT MIN(user_id) FROM groupbuy_member WHERE team_id=#{teamId} AND status IN (0,1)),0), status=CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM groupbuy_member WHERE team_id=#{teamId} AND status IN (0,1)) THEN 3 ELSE status END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{teamId} AND status=1
mapper.select: SELECT t.id FROM groupbuy_team t WHERE t.expire_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND ( t.status=1 OR (t.status=3 AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM groupbuy_member m JOIN `order` o ON o.id=m.order_id WHERE m.team_id=t.id AND o.inventory_released=FALSE )) ) ORDER BY t.expire_at,t.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE groupbuy_team SET status=3,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{teamId} AND status=1 AND expire_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
